name: exchange_of_partners
summary: Flip the coordinates of (U, W) to (W, flipSpace U); build matched data at the top of the tower (`exists_stdExchange_top` after `exists_rapid_with_realSlice`), descend by removing the planes of A, and extend the identity from standard data to all partners with the equivariant lift (`partner_mem_of_stdColDatum`).

steps.claim: Not a step of the proof: lines 102–105 are the rest of the statement, which ends before the `:=` on line 105 (a second-reader message). The line census takes the `:=` of `let γ :=` on line 102 for the start of the value, so the check requires these lines to be owned here. They state: γ = rankTwist(ν_𝔠⁻¹, n); there is c with C·|c|² = lValueProdInt(𝔠, |r| − |n|/2)·equalRankThetaRatio(hypSum(Unit, X), 𝔠, z) such that for all Φ, Ψ with Ψ locally constant and IsPartner(O, σ, χ_𝔠, Φ, Ψ), and every g: thetaIntegral(W, V, γ, 1, localDatum(W, V, v, Φ, readsAt(𝔠)))(g) = c·∫ pairTheta(U, W, γ, γ, localDatum(U, W, y, Ψ, readsAt(𝔠)), (h, g)) dh over [U(U)].
steps.lean:
SplitTameChar E μ, let γ := rankTwist 𝔠.ν⁻¹ n; ∃ c, C * ‖c‖ ^ 2 = lValueProdInt 𝔠 (card r - card
    n / 2) * equalRankThetaRatio (hypSum Unit X) 𝔠 z ∧ ∀ Φ Ψ, IsLocallyConstant Ψ → IsPartner
    SemilocalField.O σ 𝔠.χ Φ Ψ → ∀ g, thetaIntegral W V γ 1 (localDatum W V v Φ 𝔠.readsAt) g =
    c * ∫ h, pairTheta U W γ γ (localDatum U W y Ψ 𝔠.readsAt) (h, g) ∂U.quotMeasure := by

steps.claim: Let f be the flip of coordinates from Hom(U, W) to Hom(W, flipSpace(U)) (conjugating the coordinates with the norm-one element).
steps.lean: let f := flipCoords (E := E) (s := s) star_normNegOne_mul_self (t := u) rfl

steps.claim: The flipped datum f(y) is rapid: the flip preserves the weighted norms (it is a measure-preserving isometry of the Fock models, `Heisenberg.IsVacuum.measurePreserving_equiv`).
steps.lean:
have : IsRapidDatum
    (f.realMap y) := by simpa [IsRapidDatum, weightedNorm, enorm, fun x ↦ (eq_of_forall_ge_iff (by
    simp [f, flipCoords, starCoordEquiv, ↓pi_nnnorm_le_iff, nnnorm]; tauto) : ‖f.realEquiv
    x‖₊ = ‖x‖₊), ← (Heisenberg.IsVacuum.measurePreserving_equiv (realHeis 1) (realHeis 1)
    f.vac_realEquiv).lintegral_comp_emb f.realEquiv.measurableEmbedding] using! hy

steps.claim: `exists_rapid_with_realSlice` for the opposite splitting of A and a smooth non-negative bump u with u(0) ≠ 0: a rapid w (a) whose slice at 0 is f(y) (e).
steps.lean:
obtain ⟨_, w, a, e, -⟩ := exists_rapid_with_realSlice A.symm _ _ (u_smooth _) this
    (u_compact_support _) u_nonneg 0 ((u_support _).ge (by simp))

steps.claim: `exists_stdExchange_top` at the top of the tower (hypSum(Unit, X) over X along a line, flipSpace(U)): x and x′ with slice w at 0 and StdExchange with the ratio equalRankThetaRatio(hypSum(Unit, X), ·, z) (H); and |n| = 2k (hn).
steps.lean:
obtain ⟨⟨x, u, rfl, H⟩, _, k⟩ := exists_stdExchange_top (removePlanes ..) (removePlanes _ X)
    (flipSpace U) (.symm (.sumAssoc ..)) (by grind [A.card_eq]) μ a r₁, id hn

steps.claim: Descend by removing the planes of A (`exists_stdExchange_removing_planes`, part (1)), identifying the slices (`slice_zero_comp`): StdExchange for (W, V, flipSpace(U)) with a rapid datum rv, a constant C and constants c(𝔠) with identities K on standard data.
steps.lean:
choose rv _ C c _ K using e ▸ slice_zero_comp _ _ (removePlanes ..).symm A u ▸
    (exists_stdExchange_removing_planes _ _ _ μ 0 0 V σ _
    (by simp; grind [negCount_neg_add]) hn).choose_spec.1 _ _ H

steps.claim: Take C and v = rv; fix 𝔠.
Let t be the component at S of the norm-one element (used by the flip).

The flip of theta kernels (`exists_pairTheta_flip`: |d| = 1 and the flipped kernel is d times the kernel of (U, W)); the reading map r; and the equivariant lift (M, 𝒟) of thetaLarge − c(𝔠)·thetaSmall for (W, V, flipSpace(U)) (`exists_isEquivariantLift`; R).
steps.lean:
obtain ⟨⟨d, _, H⟩, r, _, 𝒟, h, R⟩ := exists_pairTheta_flip star_normNegOne_mul_self rfl U W
    (flipSpace U) 1 (by simp [flipSpace, ← ext_iff]) _, 𝔠.readsAt,
    exists_isEquivariantLift W V (flipSpace U) 𝔠 σ hn rv this (c 𝔠)

steps.claim: Take c′ = c(𝔠)·χ_𝔠(t)^{|b|}·d: since |χ_𝔠(t)| = |d| = 1 (`TameLocalChar.norm_eq_one`), the norm relation is that of step 6; fix partners Φ, Ψ (m: Ψ locally constant; P) and g.
steps.lean:
use c 𝔠 * 𝔠.χ t ^ card b * d, by simp [*, TameLocalChar.norm_eq_one, isIntegralUnit_iff_isUnit.2],
    fun Φ Ψ m P g ↦ ?_

steps.claim: Rewrite the right side through the flip: the integral over [U(U)] of the kernel of (U, W) becomes that over the opposite group of the flipped kernel.
steps.lean: rw [mul_assoc, ← integral_const_mul, ← funext fun l ↦ H _ _ l _ l.neg (by simp)]

steps.claim: The local datum of the flipped pair with Ψ(·ᵀ) equals χ_𝔠(t)^{|b|} times the flip of the local datum of (U, W) with Ψ: naming commutes with the flip (`map_integrated`, `map_name`) and the partner Ψ transforms by χ under the scalar t (`IsPartner.right_mul`).
steps.lean:
have : localDatum W (flipSpace U) (f.realMap y) (Ψ ·ᵀ) r.star =
    𝔠.χ t ^ card b • f.map (localDatum U W y Ψ r) := by
    rw [map_integrated, map_name _ _ _ r.1 r.star.1 (hΨ :=
      r.isSchwartzBruhat (h.le_schwartzBruhat (R m P).1)), ← map_smul, Space.smul_name]
    congr!; dsimp; rw [← P.right_mul _ ⟨.scalar _ t, rfl⟩, mul_comm]; congr
    all_goals (try unfold f flipCoords starCoordEquiv); simp [vecToMat, funext_iff, mul_left_comm,
      star_idem, starRingEnd_apply, Set.conjClosure, ← ext_iff, field, t]
steps.typed_fact:
localDatum W (flipSpace U) (f.realMap y) (Ψ ·ᵀ) r.star =
    𝔠.χ t ^ card b • f.map (localDatum U W y Ψ r)

steps.claim: 𝒟Ψ = 0: M ∩ ker 𝒟 is GL-stable (`IsEquivariantLift.comp_mul_mem_ker`) and contains the standard datum of the primitive matrix firstCols(σ, 1) (by K, `isPrimitiveMatrix_firstCols`), hence contains Ψ (`partner_mem_of_stdColDatum`); so thetaLarge(Φ) = c(𝔠)·thetaSmall(Ψ), which, multiplied by the character value at det g and rewritten with the flip, step 12 and the integral over the opposite space (`isForm_neg_iff_and_integral_neg`), is the claim.
steps.lean:
convert congr((rankTwist 𝔠.ν⁻¹ n).1 g.det * $(sub_eq_zero.1
    ((R m P).2.symm.trans ((isPrimitiveMatrix_firstCols σ (one_mem _)).rec fun j ⟨s, i, e⟩ ↦
    (partner_mem_of_stdColDatum h.comp_mul_mem_ker (inf_le_left.trans h.le_schwartzBruhat) m P ((R
    (stdColDatum_mem_schwartzBruhat _ i).1 (isPartner_stdRowDatum_stdColDatum σ i)).imp_right
    (by simp [*])) j i e 1 (by simp) _).2)))
    g) using 1 <;> simp [thetaIntegral, isForm_neg_iff_and_integral_neg U (flipSpace U), pairTheta,
    pairWeil, rankTwist, ↓this, *, ← integral_const_mul]

steps.claim: The remaining identities of integrands are field identities.
